title: Recipe Init Scaffold Command
description: Add a `recipe-init` command that scaffolds a new recipe file from minimal inputs and optional workspace hints.

riskProbes.title: Generated recipe fails schema validation
riskProbes.advice: Validate scaffold output through ExecutionRecipeSchema before writing.

steps.title: Define scaffold contract
steps.description: Specify minimal required inputs and output file conventions for new recipes.

steps.title: Implement recipe-init command
steps.description: Generate starter recipe JSON with sane defaults and optional inferred preconditions.

steps.title: Add scaffold tests
steps.description: Add tests that validate scaffolded recipe schema and CLI UX.

steps.title: Update recipe authoring docs
steps.description: Add README guidance for creating and running new recipes end-to-end.

gates.title: CLI + recipe tests pass
gates.command: npm --prefix packages/orchestrator-standalone run test:run -- src/recipes/generator.test.ts src/autonomy/task-synthesizer.test.ts

rollbackHints: Keep existing recipe-generate and recipe-intake behavior unchanged.

edgeCases: User provides recipe id that already exists in catalog.
